# Android Talk Design System

> A 1920x1080 slide design system for tech talks: white canvases, Google green and lime accents, blue/green highlight words, dark code panels, 27 slide components. Read DESIGN.md first; build slides in HTML with tokens/tokens.css and css/slides.css.

## Spec
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): rules, tokens, typography, layout, every component, checklist

## Implementation
- [tokens/tokens.css](tokens/tokens.css): CSS custom properties and type classes
- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): the same tokens as data
- [css/slides.css](css/slides.css): slide primitives
- [examples/deck.html](examples/deck.html): complete example deck with navigation
